project_metadata.user_directive: Feedback only - do not alter code

login_page_design_audit.overall_assessment: The current login page is clean and functional with solid baseline branding and accessibility tags. However, it suffers from a critical mobile layout issue (CTA below fold), lacks essential SaaS login features (Remember Me, SSO, Security Trust signals, Legal footer), and exhibits minor background color vibration.

prioritized_feedback.issue: Vertical stacking on mobile screens (390x844) cuts off the main 'Login' button below the fold.
prioritized_feedback.details: The left graphic panel takes up ~42vh (~390px) on mobile viewports. This pushes the login card downwards, forcing users to scroll down just to see and tap the primary CTA button.
prioritized_feedback.recommendation: On screens smaller than desktop (`< lg`), hide the top visual panel (`hidden lg:flex`) or compress it into a small horizontal logo banner (~10-15vh). The login form card must be 100% visible above the fold on all mobile devices.

prioritized_feedback.details:
1. 'Remember Me' / 'Keep me logged in' checkbox is missing.
2. Enterprise Single Sign-On (SSO) button (e.g. 'Sign in with SSO' / Okta / Azure AD) is missing.
3. Legal & Compliance footer links (Privacy Policy, Terms of Service, System Status) are missing.
prioritized_feedback.recommendation: Add a 'Remember Me' checkbox alongside the 'Forgot Password?' link. Include an 'Or continue with SSO' button for enterprise corporate clients. Add a discrete footer with Privacy Policy and Terms of Service.

prioritized_feedback.issue: Background gradient vibration and unanchored card styling.
prioritized_feedback.details: The right panel uses a multi-stop pastel aqua gradient (`bg-[linear-gradient(145deg,#dff7ed_0%,#cbeee8_45%,#c8e7f0_100%)]`). Combined with the left panel's `#ccefe8` background, it creates color saturation overload and reduces contrast around the white card.
prioritized_feedback.recommendation: Use a subtle, neutral off-white background with warm organic undertones (`bg-[#f8faf9]` or `bg-slate-50`) behind the card. Replace flat card borders (`border-white/80`) with a crisp 1px border (`border-emerald-900/10` or `border-slate-200/80`) for better edge definition.

prioritized_feedback.issue: Lack of security and enterprise trust indicators.
prioritized_feedback.details: In an ESG & enterprise carbon accounting platform handling sensitive corporate environmental data, the login page lacks security assurance badges.
prioritized_feedback.recommendation: Add a small, subtle security badge near the bottom of the card (e.g., '🔒 256-Bit Encrypted • Enterprise ESG Security').

prioritized_feedback.issue: Placeholder text contrast and focus ring definition.
prioritized_feedback.details: Placeholder text (`#7e9997`) is slightly faint. Input focus rings use a soft opacity ring which can be hard to see under bright direct light.
prioritized_feedback.recommendation: Increase placeholder contrast to `#64748b` (Slate-500). Standardize focus ring to a high-contrast emerald focus indicator (`focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-emerald-600`).

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Do not modify user code when feedback-only is requested.
Ensure login CTA buttons remain above the fold on mobile viewports (390px width).
Always provide 'Remember Me' and SSO options for enterprise SaaS login interfaces.
Maintain accessible color contrast (4.5:1 ratio) on placeholders and form inputs.
Ensure all interactive elements feature data-testid attributes.
